_key.description: Variant key, Ensembl protein ID and the source name joined by underscores.

rsid.description: dbSNP identifier of the variant. Null when the source has none.

neg_log10_pvalue.description: Negative log10 of the discovery-cohort association p-value (UKB-PPP column log10(p)). Larger values mean stronger association.

beta.description: Discovery-cohort effect size of allele A1 on plasma protein level.

se.description: Standard error of the discovery-cohort beta.

regulatory_type.description: Whether the association is cis (within 1 Mb of the gene encoding the protein) or trans.

gene.description: Ensembl gene the source annotates at this locus, as a handle into genes. Null when the annotation is missing or the identifier is not in the catalog.

gene_consequence.description: Sequence Ontology consequence of the variant on the annotated gene. Null when none is recorded.

biological_context.description: Tissue the pQTL was measured in. UKB-PPP used blood plasma.

biosample_term.description: Ontology term for blood plasma, as a handle into ontology_terms.

files_filesets.description: Handle of the files_filesets record for the IGVF file this pQTL table was read from.

accessible_via.name: variants_proteins
accessible_via.return: label, neg_log10_pvalue, beta, se, gene, gene_consequence, source, source_url, method, class, regulatory_type, files_filesets
